Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Humanity needed a solution. The atmosphere was failing.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: we built a tower in the sky and handed control over to a system.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: OZONE.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: It was meant to protect our airspace. Maintain the shield.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Now its locked us out.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Every unit we sent has gone. You werent built for this. But you are all we have.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Input check - [W] [A] [S] [D] for movement. [Space] to jump.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Keep it steady. Take that pipe ahead.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Skill check - [Right Mouse Button] to [Dash]. Use it to gain distance.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: No faults detected. You're holding together.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Stay on task. Console's ahead. That's your access point to OZONE.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Hostile unit detected. Avoid direct confrontation. You're not built for it.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: It will telegraph before it fires. Watch out.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Terminal's at the end of the tunnel.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: That's our way in.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Dodge everything it throws at you.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: We have visuals. Access terminal's in range.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: I've found another path. Just through the gate. It'll take you to OZONE.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: But it's not clean. Expect heavier resistance.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: This...It locks us out of the mainframe.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: This isn't playing out the way we had hoped.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: If we can't access it through the system... We force our way in.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Previous iterations failed at this point. There should be a weapon you can use.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: I know you weren't made for this. But this is our last shot.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: You are armed now. [Left Mouse Button] to attack.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: Visuals confirmed. That's the main body.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: You're on your own from here. Good luck. HQ out.

Name: OZONE
Text: Interference detected. Initiating extermination protocol.

Name: OZONE
Text: You leave me no choice.

Name: OZONE
Text: I asked you to stop.

Name: OZONE
Text: Why do you go to such lengths?

Name: OZONE
Text: Who sent you?

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: It's generating shields. Destroy it first.

Name: HEADQUARTERS
Text: This is the final push.
